description:
Diamond pipeline: one build fans out to two parallel checks that then rejoin at a deploy.
The two middle steps overlap in time; deploy waits for both.

steps.desc: compile the app (fans out to two checks)
steps.description:
Compile the application once.
Both downstream checks depend on this single build artifact.
Unit tests. Larger est_duration_s, so LPT dispatches this branch first.
Lint. Runs concurrently with the unit branch.
Deploy to staging. Waits for BOTH checks; skipped if either fails.
